full_judgment:
2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted a suit for permanent injunction in the court of learned Munsif at Bhaluka, being others Class suit No. 44 of 1986. The case of the plaintiff in short is that, the land of C. S. Khatian No. 2 of Mouza Bhayabaha belonged to Ramani Kishore Roy and Ranadha Kishore Roy in 8 annas share each; that Ranada Kishore turned his portion of the said land as Debater property, and appointed his wife jyotirmoyee Debi Shebait for the same; and said jyotirmoyee Debi settled 1.60 acres of land from C.S. Khatian No. 2 Dag No. 2. With plaintiff on 12th Aswin, 1352 B.S. on receipt of near salami and since then he has been owing and possessing the land; that during the S.A. operation the lands of C.S. Khatian No. 2 were wrongly recorded in the name of jyotirmoyee Debi, that on 14.6.1977 the said jyotirmoyee Debi executed and registered a deed of relinquishment in favour of the plaintiff in respect of 1.62 acres of land following which the plaintiff mutated his name and since then he has been paying rent to the Government Acquired Estate, that jyotirmoyee Debi also settled 2.23 acres of land from plot No. 206 of C.S. Khatian No. 2 with Rez Ali by way of pettan nama dated 12th chaitra, 1352 B.S. and the said pattandar owned and possessed the same; that the said Rez Ali sold to the plaintiff 1.92 acres of land from C.S. plot No. 206 by a registered sale deed dated 6.1.77 and since then he has been owing and possessing the same on payment of rent to the Government Estate, after mutating his name in respect thereof that S.A. Khatian has been correctly prepared in the name of Rez Ali and others; that defendants having no title and possession in the suit land illegally tried to dispossess the plaintiff from the suit land on 1st Baishakh, 1393 B.S. and hence the suit (for permanent injunction). 

 3. The defendant No. 1 contested the suit by filing a written statement denying the material allegations of the plaint and contended inter' alia that the plaintiffs purchase of land from plot No. 206 by kabala dated 6.1.77 is illega1 and that the plaintiffs story of pattan is also false and the plaintiff has no tittle and possession in the suit land; that the defendant purchased 1.96 acres from plot No. 2 and. 68 acre of land form plot No. 206 by kabalas dated 18.7.66 and he owns and possesses the same land; and that the defendant's wife purchased 1.68 acres of land from plot No. 206 and she owns and possessed the same through her husband; that by another kabala dated 9.1.67 he purchased 9 decimals from plot No. 2 and 2.24 acres from Plot No. 206 this way the defendant is in possession of the land in question and as such time suit is liable to be discharged.
